recommended_action: Visit cardiology within 24 hours; perform ECG and blood pressure check.
Seek emergency care if severe; otherwise
Monitor temperature; take paracetamol and rest; visit doctor if persistent.
Hydrate and avoid irritants; consult if cough lasts more than 3 days.
Gargle with warm salt water; visit ENT if throat pain lasts more than 2 days.
Take adequate rest; if recurring or severe
Check blood pressure and sugar; consult neurologist if persistent.
Avoid heavy food; visit gastroenterologist if pain continues.
Apply heat and rest; consult orthopedist if pain lasts >3 days.
Avoid allergens; apply soothing cream; consult dermatologist if rash spreads.
Check thyroid and hemoglobin levels; consult endocrinologist if frequent.
